messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 Page created: high 504 spike from gateway -> runtime (alerts: gateway.gateway_504_rate > 15/min). Paging oncall-sre and mike-runtime.

oncall-sre: seeing it in the dashboard. Gateway 504s started ~3412345600 and ramped. 90th latency for /v1/generate at 1.5s -> 6s before 504s.

mike-runtime: thanks — any recent deploys? I don't see a rollout in eng-releases during the window. Checking runtime pool health.

rebecca-eng: no deploys from product in the last hour. We pushed a small autoscaler tweak yesterday but that was low-risk.

sam-support: customer reports: webhooks failing, retries are backing up. Affected orgs: org_88, org_113, org_alpha-corp. High business impact for org_alpha-corp (order confirmations).

oncall-sre: confirmed. Traffic pattern shows burst of long-tail requests with large seq_length near 8k tokens causing KV cache pressure and upstream timeouts.

mike-runtime: runtime logs are thin for those requests — we don't have request-id consistently on edges for retries. Missing tracing on many 504s. Observability gap.

rebecca-eng: agreed — our trace sampler is 1% in prod; full traces not enabled for these orgs. We need a stopgap to correlate requests across gateway and runtime.

oncall-sre: plan: 1) Add an Envoy header-inserter to guarantee X-Req-Id at the gateway for all incoming requests (edge filter). 2) Temporarily bump trace sampling to 100% for traffic with header X-Debug-Org in (org_alpha-corp, org_113). 3) Apply a per-route timeout increase to /v1/generate from 5s -> 10s for a 5m window to let inflight requests finish.

mike-runtime: can do 1 and 2 via a quick envoy patch and sampler flag. Deploy to canary region A first. I'll push a small config and roll canary in 2m.

rebecca-eng: I can flip the per-route timeout in gateway config now. Patching: 
```yaml
route: /v1/generate
timeout_ms: 10000  # was 5000
match: host: "api.redwood.example"
```
I'll push with a 10% canary then 100% in 3m if no regressions.

devex-bot: note: enabling full traces for customers may increase trace storage. Adding temporary retention flag.

sam-support: FYI to support — customer-facing message prepped: "We're seeing intermittent webhook timeouts; we've applied temporary mitigations and will provide a follow-up. No data loss reported." Please review before sending.

ashley-qa: quick safety checks: full sampling = more CPU on tracer pipeline. Please watch tracing ingestion and backpressure. Also ensure we don't expose PII in sampled traces.

mike-runtime: rolling envoy header-inserter to canary. Config snippet: 
```yaml
filters:
 - name: envoy.lua
   typed_config:
     '@type': type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.lua.v3.Lua
     inline_code: |
       function envoy_on_request(request_handle)
         local id = request_handle:headers():get('x-request-id')
         if not id then
           local gen = os.time() .. '-' .. math.random(1000,9999)
           request_handle:headers():add('x-request-id', gen)
         end
       end
```
Canary up in region A 3412345780.

oncall-sre: after canary we should do a narrow log-grep on runtime to confirm header present and correlate with existing metrics. Use the new header to join logs -> traces.

mike-runtime: canary looked good. Header present. Sampling flag toggled for org headers. Full traces for org_alpha-corp and org_113 enabled at 3412345905.

sam-support: sent the customer note (internal copy) to stakeholders. Waiting on confirmation before public.

rebecca-eng: gateway timeout bump in canary applied, no immediate increase in error rate. Rolling to 100% now.

oncall-sre: we're seeing 504 rate dropping from 20/min -> 6/min post-changes. Latency tail still elevated for large sequences, but many requests now succeed.

ashley-qa: tracing ingestion spiked ~3x for sampled orgs — tracer queue filled briefly; collector autoscaling kicked in. Watch for any OOMs in the collector.

mike-runtime: added temporary log line in runtime to surface kv_cache.size and seq_len for requests with x-request-id to better diagnose pressure: 
```text
[INFO] x-request-id=%s kv_cache_slots=... seq_len=...
```
These logs are gated behind an env var and only enabled for requests with X-Debug-Org.

oncall-sre: good. Next steps: 1) keep header inserter and sampling for 15m, 2) collect full traces for 5-10 correlated failures, 3) evaluate whether autoscaler config for runtime needs a burst headroom bump, 4) prepare rollback plan if tracing causes overload.

rebecca-eng: also propose a longer-term fix: ensure request-id enforced at LB always, increase default sampler for large requests to 10% and add dynamic sampling based on seq_length. I'll create a follow-up ticket.

sam-support: updating customers: "We've applied targeted mitigations. If you still see failing webhooks, please include X-Debug-Org header or contact support with a recent timestamp and we'll pull traces."

oncall-sre: handing off to mike-runtime for continuing mitigation and analysis. Mike, you're on until 3412346010. Please ping when we can close. :thumbsup:

mike-runtime: taking over. Will keep this thread updated. First pass looks stabilizing, collecting traces and KV metrics now.

incident-bot: incident status -> monitoring (high 504) -> mitigations applied (header insertion, trace-sample bump, timeout bump).

mike-runtime: update at 3412346010: error rate steady at ~4/min, collecting 12 full traces for analysis, no further customer escalations. I'm leaving the sampling and header inserter on for another 10m, then will revert sampling to 1% and keep header insertion permanent. Closing handoff to engineering for root-cause.

oncall-sre: acknowledged. Marking this incident as mitigated for paging purposes.

sam-support: will follow up with customers and reopen if we see regression. Thanks all. :heart:
